 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(sum(case
    when d.execution_state = 'VERIFIED' then coalesce(v.accepted_base_quantity, 0)
      + case when l.source_mode = 'SUPPLIER_DIRECT' then greatest(coalesce(private.delivery_loaded_quantity(l.id),l.planned_base_quantity)-coalesce(v.accepted_base_quantity,0)-coalesce((select sum(r.base_quantity) from public.return_cases r where r.delivery_line_id=l.id and r.case_kind in('TRANSIT_REMAINDER','TRANSIT_LOSS') and r.state in('RETURNED','LOSS_APPROVED')),0),0) else greatest(p.base_quantity, 0) end
    when d.execution_state in('DISPATCHED','ARRIVED','RESULT_SUBMITTED') then coalesce(private.delivery_loaded_quantity(l.id),l.planned_base_quantity)
    else l.planned_base_quantity end), 0)
  from public.delivery_lines l join public.deliveries d on d.id = l.delivery_id
  left join public.delivery_verification_lines v on v.delivery_line_id = l.id
  left join lateral private.delivery_line_transit_position(l.id) p on true
  where l.supply_allocation_id = target_allocation_id and d.execution_state <> 'CANCELLED'
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.delivery_has_unresolved_exception(did uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from public.return_cases r where r.state='OPEN' and r.delivery_line_id in(select id from public.delivery_lines where delivery_id=did))
 or exists(select 1 from public.deliveries d where d.id=did and d.execution_state='VERIFIED' and(
  exists(select 1 from public.inventory_movements m where m.delivery_id=d.id and m.location_kind='IN_TRANSIT'
   group by m.material_id,m.base_uom_id having sum(m.base_quantity_delta)<>0 or sum(m.inventory_value_delta_vnd)<>0)
  or exists(select 1 from public.delivery_verification_lines v join public.delivery_lines l on l.id=v.delivery_line_id
   left join public.delivery_handoff_lines h on h.delivery_line_id=l.id where l.delivery_id=d.id
   and coalesce(h.moved_base_quantity,v.actual_base_quantity)-v.accepted_base_quantity>
    coalesce((select sum(r.base_quantity) from public.return_cases r where r.delivery_line_id=l.id
      and r.case_kind in('TRANSIT_REMAINDER','TRANSIT_LOSS') and r.state in('RETURNED','LOSS_APPROVED')),0))
 ))
 or exists(select 1 from public.deliveries d where d.id=did and d.execution_state='RESULT_SUBMITTED' and d.result_kind in('PARTIAL','FAILED'))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.evidence_actor_portal_access(actor_uuid uuid, target_evidence_id uuid, require_ready boolean DEFAULT true)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.portal_evidence_objects e
    where e.id = target_evidence_id
      and (not require_ready or e.object_state = 'READY')
      and e.object_state <> 'REVOKED'
      and (
        private.evidence_actor_has_permission(actor_uuid,
          coalesce(
            (select w.branch_id from public.work_items w where w.id = e.work_item_id),
            (select c.branch_id from public.customers c where c.id = e.customer_id)
          ),
          'evidence.manage'
        )
        or (e.context_type = 'WORK_RESULT' and private.evidence_actor_is_assignee(actor_uuid,e.work_item_id))
        or (

            join public.work_item_results wr on wr.id = link.work_result_id
            join public.work_items w on w.id = wr.work_item_id

              and w.delivery_id = d.id
              and w.branch_id = d.branch_id
              and private.evidence_actor_has_permission(actor_uuid,d.branch_id, 'delivery.read')
              and private.evidence_actor_has_permission(actor_uuid,d.branch_id, 'delivery.verify')

        or (
          e.context_type = 'PAYMENT_NOTICE'
          and private.evidence_actor_customer_role(actor_uuid,e.customer_id) in ('OWNER','FINANCE_CONTACT')

        or (

          and private.evidence_actor_has_permission(actor_uuid,(select c.branch_id from public.customers c where c.id = e.customer_id), 'finance.payment_notice.review')

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.operational_direct_purchase_draft_allocation_allowed(a jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare branch_state text; draft_id uuid;
begin
 if a->>'supply_mode' is distinct from 'SUPPLIER_DIRECT'
 or a->>'warehouse_id' is not null or a->>'purchase_order_line_id' is null then return false;end if;
 select state into branch_state from private.branch_operational_states
 where branch_id=(a->>'branch_id')::uuid for share;
 if branch_state is null or branch_state not in ('PENDING_OPENING','READY_FOR_ACTIVATION') then return false;end if;
 -- Serialize against confirmation; the canonical draft editor already owns this row lock.
 select po.id into draft_id
 from public.purchase_order_lines pl
 join public.purchase_orders po on po.id=pl.purchase_order_id
 join public.sales_order_lines sl on sl.id=pl.linked_sales_order_line_id
 join public.sales_orders so on so.id=sl.sales_order_id
 where pl.id=(a->>'purchase_order_line_id')::uuid
 and po.state='DRAFT' and po.confirmed_at is null and po.cancelled_at is null
 and po.destination_type='CUSTOMER_SITE' and po.warehouse_id is null
 and po.branch_id=(a->>'branch_id')::uuid and so.branch_id=po.branch_id
 and so.id=po.source_sales_order_id and so.commercial_state in ('DRAFT','CONFIRMED')
 and so.customer_id=po.customer_id and so.site_id=po.site_id
 and sl.id=(a->>'sales_order_line_id')::uuid
 and sl.material_id=pl.material_id and sl.base_uom_id=pl.base_uom_id
 and (a->>'allocated_base_quantity')::numeric=pl.quantity*pl.conversion_numerator/pl.conversion_denominator
 for share of po;
 if draft_id is null then return false;end if;
 -- Even cancelled execution history excludes the draft exception; never rewrite source history.
 if exists(select 1 from public.purchase_receipts where purchase_order_id=draft_id)
 or exists(select 1 from public.supplier_fulfillments where purchase_order_id=draft_id)
 or exists(select 1 from public.delivery_lines dl
  join public.supply_allocations sa on sa.id=dl.supply_allocation_id
  join public.purchase_order_lines pl on pl.id=sa.purchase_order_line_id
  where pl.purchase_order_id=draft_id)
 then return false;end if;
 return true;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.preferred_commercial_price_rule(b uuid, c uuid, m uuid, u uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare chosen uuid; candidates uuid[];
begin
 with eligible as (
  select p.id,p.version,case p.scope_type when 'CUSTOMER_MATERIAL' then 4 when 'CUSTOMER_GROUP' then 3 when 'CUSTOMER_TIER' then 2 else 1 end priority
  from public.pricing_rules p join public.customers customer on customer.id=c and customer.branch_id=b and customer.active
   join public.materials material on material.id=m and material.active and material.sale_enabled
  where p.branch_id=b and p.price_uom_id=u and p.active
   and p.effective_from<=now() and(p.effective_to is null or p.effective_to>now())
   and((p.scope_type='CUSTOMER_MATERIAL' and p.customer_id=c and p.material_id=m)
    or(p.scope_type='CUSTOMER_GROUP' and p.customer_id=c and p.material_group_id=material.group_id)
    or(p.scope_type='CUSTOMER_TIER' and p.customer_tier_code is not distinct from customer.tier_code and p.material_id=m)
    or(p.scope_type='DEFAULT' and p.material_id=m))
 ), first_priority as(select priority,version from eligible order by priority desc,version desc limit 1)
 select array_agg(e.id) into candidates from eligible e join first_priority p on p.priority=e.priority and p.version=e.version;
 if coalesce(cardinality(candidates),0)=0 then raise exception 'pricing_rule_not_available' using errcode='22023';end if;
 if cardinality(candidates)>1 then raise exception 'pricing_priority_ambiguous' using errcode='22023';end if;
 chosen:=candidates[1];return chosen;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.require_active_operations(b uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare valid_start timestamptz; inserted uuid;
begin
 if b is null or auth.uid() is null or not exists(
  select 1 from public.employees e join public.employee_branch_access a on a.employee_id=e.id and a.active
  join public.roles r on r.id=a.role_id and r.active join public.branches branch on branch.id=a.branch_id and branch.active
  where e.auth_user_id=auth.uid() and e.active and a.branch_id=b)
 then raise exception 'forbidden_operational_branch' using errcode='42501';end if;
 -- Keep an already recorded start. No writer changes the opening/activation state.
 if exists(select 1 from private.branch_recorded_operations where branch_id=b) then return;end if;
 select e.recorded_at into valid_start from private.branch_operational_states s
  join private.operational_state_events e on e.operation_id=s.activation_operation_id and e.branch_id=s.branch_id
  where s.branch_id=b and s.state='ACTIVE' and e.intent->>'action'='activate';
 insert into private.branch_recorded_operations(branch_id,started_at,started_by,basis)
 values(b,coalesce(valid_start,statement_timestamp()),auth.uid(),
  case when valid_start is null then 'FIRST_RECORDED_TRANSACTION' else 'EXISTING_ACTIVATION' end)
 on conflict(branch_id) do nothing returning branch_id into inserted;
 if inserted is not null then
  insert into public.audit_events(actor_auth_user_id,branch_id,action,entity_type,entity_id,trace_id,changed_fields)
  values(auth.uid(),b,'operations.recording_started','branch',b,b,array['recorded_operations_start']);
 end if;
end $function$

 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare actual text;
begin
 select state into actual from private.branch_operational_states where branch_id=b for share;
 if actual is distinct from 'PENDING_OPENING' then
  raise exception 'opening_requires_pending_state' using errcode='PT423';
 end if;
 if not exists(
  select 1 from private.operational_opening_executions x
  join private.operational_opening_packages a on a.id=x.package_id
  join private.operational_recovery_checkpoints r on r.id=a.recovery_id and r.branch_id=a.branch_id
  where x.transaction_id=pg_current_xact_id() and a.branch_id=b
   and a.status='APPROVED' and a.approved_by is not null and a.approved_at is not null
   and a.actor_id=a.approved_by and a.recovery_accepted_at is not null
   and a.expires_at>clock_timestamp() and r.expires_at>clock_timestamp()
   and exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(a.source_manifest) m
     where m->>'kind'=kind and m->'payload'=p)
 ) then raise exception 'opening_authorization_required' using errcode='42501'; end if;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.supplier_document_source(target_kind text, target_id uuid, target_branch_id uuid, target_supplier_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(purchase_line_id uuid, material_id uuid, uom_id uuid, quantity numeric, unit_cost numeric, value_vnd bigint, return_charge_vnd bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if target_kind='RECEIPT_LINE' then
  return query select pl.id,l.material_id,pl.ordered_uom_id,l.received_quantity,l.unit_cost_vnd::numeric,l.inventory_value_vnd,0::bigint
   from public.purchase_receipt_lines l join public.purchase_receipts r on r.id=l.purchase_receipt_id join public.purchase_orders p on p.id=r.purchase_order_id
   join public.purchase_order_lines pl on pl.id=l.purchase_order_line_id where l.id=target_id and r.branch_id=target_branch_id and p.supplier_id=target_supplier_id;
 elsif target_kind='FULFILLMENT_LINE' then
  return query select pl.id,pl.material_id,pl.ordered_uom_id,l.supplier_quantity,pl.unit_cost_vnd::numeric,l.payable_amount_vnd,0::bigint
   from public.supplier_fulfillment_lines l join public.supplier_fulfillments f on f.id=l.supplier_fulfillment_id join public.purchase_orders p on p.id=f.purchase_order_id
   join public.purchase_order_lines pl on pl.id=l.purchase_order_line_id where l.id=target_id and f.branch_id=target_branch_id and p.supplier_id=target_supplier_id;
 elsif target_kind='RETURN_CREDIT' then
  return query select pl.id,c.material_id,c.base_uom_id,e.base_quantity,round(pl.unit_cost_vnd::numeric*pl.conversion_denominator/pl.conversion_numerator,6),credit.approved_credit_vnd,e.source_value_vnd-credit.approved_credit_vnd
   from public.supplier_return_credits credit join public.supplier_return_cases c on c.id=credit.case_id join public.supplier_return_events e on e.id=credit.acceptance_event_id
   left join public.purchase_receipt_lines rl on rl.id=c.source_receipt_line_id left join public.supplier_fulfillment_lines fl on fl.id=c.source_fulfillment_line_id
   join public.purchase_order_lines pl on pl.id=coalesce(rl.purchase_order_line_id,fl.purchase_order_line_id)
   where credit.id=target_id and credit.branch_id=target_branch_id and credit.supplier_id=target_supplier_id;
 end if;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.customer_portal_order(target_order_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  order_row record;
  member_role text;
  result_json jsonb;
  debt_json jsonb := null;
  payments_json jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  quotation_documents jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  delivery_documents jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  payment_documents jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
begin
  select * into order_row from public.sales_order_read o where o.id = target_order_id;
  if order_row.id is null then raise exception 'order_not_found' using errcode = '23503'; end if;

  member_role := private.portal_customer_role(order_row.customer_id);
  if member_role is null then
    raise exception 'forbidden_or_order_not_found' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  result_json := private.customer_order_payload(target_order_id);

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id', 'delivery-' || d.id::text,
    'kind', 'DELIVERY',
    'title', 'Phiếu giao ' || d.delivery_number,
    'state', d.execution_state,
    'issued_at', coalesce(d.verified_at, d.created_at)
  ) order by d.created_at, d.id), '[]'::jsonb)
  into delivery_documents
  from public.delivery_read d
  where d.sales_order_id = target_order_id;

  if order_row.quotation_revision_id is not null then
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id', 'quotation-' || qr.id::text,
      'kind', 'QUOTATION',
      'title', 'Báo giá ' || q.quotation_number || ' · R' || qr.revision_number::text,
      'state', qr.state,
      'issued_at', coalesce(qr.sent_at, qr.created_at),
      'href', '/api/quotation-revisions/' || qr.id::text || '/pdf'
    )), '[]'::jsonb)
    into quotation_documents
    from public.quotation_revisions qr
    join public.quotations q on q.id = qr.quotation_id
    where qr.id = order_row.quotation_revision_id
      and q.customer_id = order_row.customer_id;
  end if;

  if member_role in ('OWNER', 'FINANCE_CONTACT') then
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'original_amount_vnd', coalesce(sum(r.original_amount_vnd), 0),
      'outstanding_amount_vnd', coalesce(sum(r.outstanding_amount_vnd), 0),
      'items', coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', r.id,
        'source_type', r.source_type,
        'source_number', r.source_label,
        'original_amount_vnd', r.original_amount_vnd,
        'outstanding_amount_vnd', r.outstanding_amount_vnd,
        'due_date', r.due_date
      ) order by r.due_date, r.id) filter (where r.id is not null), '[]'::jsonb)
    )
    into debt_json
    from public.receivable_read r
    where r.sales_order_id = target_order_id;

    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id', payment.id,
      'number', payment.payment_number,
      'amount_vnd', payment.amount_vnd,
      'allocated_amount_vnd', payment.allocated_amount_vnd,
      'order_allocated_amount_vnd', payment.order_allocated_amount_vnd::text,
      'effective_at', payment.effective_at,
      'state', payment.posting_state,
      'reconciliation_state', payment.reconciliation_state
    ) order by payment.effective_at desc, payment.id), '[]'::jsonb)
    into payments_json
    from (
      select p.id, p.payment_number, p.amount_vnd, p.allocated_amount_vnd,
        p.effective_at, p.posting_state, p.reconciliation_state,
        sum(a.amount_delta_vnd)::bigint as order_allocated_amount_vnd
      from public.payment_read p
      join public.payment_allocations a on a.payment_id = p.id
      join public.receivable_read r on r.id = a.receivable_obligation_id
      where r.sales_order_id = target_order_id
        and p.customer_id = order_row.customer_id
      group by p.id, p.payment_number, p.amount_vnd, p.allocated_amount_vnd,
        p.effective_at, p.posting_state, p.reconciliation_state
      order by p.effective_at desc, p.id
      limit 50
    ) payment;

    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id', 'payment-' || payment.id::text,
      'kind', 'PAYMENT',
      'title', 'Phiếu thu ' || payment.payment_number,
      'state', payment.posting_state,
      'issued_at', payment.effective_at
    ) order by payment.effective_at desc, payment.id), '[]'::jsonb)
    into payment_documents
    from (
      select distinct p.id, p.payment_number, p.effective_at, p.posting_state
      from public.payment_read p
      join public.payment_allocations a on a.payment_id = p.id
      join public.receivable_read r on r.id = a.receivable_obligation_id
      where r.sales_order_id = target_order_id
        and p.customer_id = order_row.customer_id
      order by p.effective_at desc, p.id
      limit 50
    ) payment;
  end if;

  return result_json || jsonb_build_object(
    'can_view_finance', member_role in ('OWNER', 'FINANCE_CONTACT'),
    'debt', debt_json,
    'payments', payments_json,
    'documents', quotation_documents || delivery_documents || payment_documents
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dispatch_board_page(target_branch_id uuid, target_bucket text, target_q text, target_offset integer, target_limit integer)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, delivery_number text, customer_name_snapshot text, site_name_snapshot text, execution_state text, result_kind text, scheduled_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  safe_offset integer := greatest(0, least(coalesce(target_offset, 0), 250000));
  safe_limit integer := greatest(1, least(coalesce(target_limit, 26), 26));
  q text := coalesce(target_q, '');
begin
  if not private.has_permission(target_branch_id, 'delivery.read')
     or target_bucket not in ('planned', 'assigned', 'active', 'exception')
     or length(q) > 80 then
    raise exception 'dispatch_forbidden' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  if target_bucket = 'planned' and q = '' then
    return query
      select d.id, d.delivery_number, d.customer_name_snapshot, d.site_name_snapshot,
        d.execution_state, d.result_kind, d.scheduled_at
      from public.deliveries d
      where d.branch_id = target_branch_id and d.execution_state = 'PLANNED'
      order by d.scheduled_at asc nulls last, d.id asc
      offset safe_offset limit safe_limit;
  else
    return query
      select d.id, d.delivery_number, d.customer_name_snapshot, d.site_name_snapshot,
        d.execution_state, d.result_kind, d.scheduled_at
      from public.deliveries d
      where d.branch_id = target_branch_id and d.execution_state <> 'CANCELLED'
        and (
          (target_bucket = 'planned' and d.execution_state = 'PLANNED')
          or (target_bucket = 'assigned' and d.execution_state = 'ASSIGNED')
          or (target_bucket = 'active' and d.execution_state in ('DISPATCHED', 'ARRIVED', 'RESULT_SUBMITTED'))
          or (target_bucket = 'exception' and private.delivery_has_unresolved_exception(d.id))
        )
        and (q = '' or d.delivery_number ilike '%' || q || '%'
          or d.customer_name_snapshot ilike '%' || q || '%'
          or d.site_name_snapshot ilike '%' || q || '%')
      order by d.scheduled_at asc nulls last, d.id asc
      offset safe_offset limit safe_limit;
  end if;
end;
$function$

functions.args: target_branch_id uuid, from_inclusive timestamp with time zone, to_exclusive timestamp with time zone, knowledge_cutoff timestamp with time zone, target_customer_id uuid, target_site_id uuid, target_sales_employee_id uuid, target_activity_kind text
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finance_dashboard_detail(target_branch_id uuid, from_inclusive timestamp with time zone, to_exclusive timestamp with time zone, knowledge_cutoff timestamp with time zone, target_customer_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, target_site_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, target_sales_employee_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, target_activity_kind text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  effective_to timestamptz := least(to_exclusive, now());
  effective_cutoff timestamptz := least(knowledge_cutoff, now());
  can_expense boolean;
  can_compensation boolean;
  expense_not_applicable boolean := false;
  expense_quality text;
  commission_quality text;
  expense_items jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  commission_items jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
begin
  if not private.has_permission(target_branch_id, 'dashboard.read') then
    raise exception 'forbidden' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  if from_inclusive >= to_exclusive then
    raise exception 'invalid_report_period' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  can_expense := private.has_permission(target_branch_id, 'finance.expense.read');
  can_compensation := private.has_permission(target_branch_id, 'compensation.read');

  if can_expense then
    expense_not_applicable :=
      (target_customer_id is not null or target_site_id is not null or target_sales_employee_id is not null)
      and (
        exists (
          select 1
          from public.expenses e
          where e.branch_id = target_branch_id
            and e.approval_state = 'APPROVED'
            and e.effective_at >= from_inclusive
            and e.effective_at < effective_to
            and e.approved_at <= effective_cutoff
            and (
              (target_customer_id is not null and e.customer_id is null)
              or (target_site_id is not null and e.site_id is null)
              or (target_sales_employee_id is not null and e.sales_employee_id is null)
            )
        )
        or exists (
          select 1
          from public.earning_events ee
          where ee.branch_id = target_branch_id
            and ee.approval_state = 'APPROVED'
            and ee.classification = 'OPEX'
            and ee.manual_basis_id is not null
            and ee.approved_at >= from_inclusive
            and ee.approved_at < effective_to
            and ee.approved_at <= effective_cutoff
        )
      );
  end if;

  expense_quality := case
    when not can_expense then 'FORBIDDEN'
    when expense_not_applicable then 'NOT_APPLICABLE'
    else 'READY'
  end;

  if expense_quality = 'READY' then
    with raw_expense as (
      select
        'EXPENSE'::text as source_kind,
        coalesce(ec.name, ec.code, 'Chi phi khac')::text as label,
        e.amount_vnd::bigint as amount_vnd
      from public.expenses e
      left join public.expense_categories ec on ec.id = e.category_id
      where e.branch_id = target_branch_id
        and e.approval_state = 'APPROVED'
        and e.effective_at >= from_inclusive
        and e.effective_at < effective_to
        and e.approved_at <= effective_cutoff
        and (target_customer_id is null or e.customer_id = target_customer_id)
        and (target_site_id is null or e.site_id = target_site_id)
        and (target_sales_employee_id is null or e.sales_employee_id = target_sales_employee_id)
        and (target_activity_kind is null or e.activity_kind = target_activity_kind)

      union all

      select
        'EARNING'::text as source_kind,
        case
          when ee.classification = 'SALES_COMMISSION' then 'Hoa hong ban hang'
          else 'Chi phi nhan su van hanh'
        end::text as label,
        ee.approved_amount_vnd::bigint as amount_vnd
      from public.earning_events ee
      left join public.sales_orders so on so.id = ee.sales_order_id
      left join public.service_verifications sv on sv.id = ee.service_verification_id
      left join public.service_jobs sj on sj.id = sv.service_job_id
      where ee.branch_id = target_branch_id
        and ee.approval_state = 'APPROVED'
        and ee.classification in ('OPEX', 'SALES_COMMISSION')
        and ee.approved_at >= from_inclusive
        and ee.approved_at < effective_to
        and ee.approved_at <= effective_cutoff
        and (target_customer_id is null or coalesce(so.customer_id, sj.customer_id) = target_customer_id)
        and (target_site_id is null or coalesce(so.site_id, sj.site_id) = target_site_id)
        and (target_sales_employee_id is null or ee.employee_id = target_sales_employee_id)
        and (
          target_activity_kind is null
          or (target_activity_kind = 'SALES' and ee.classification = 'SALES_COMMISSION')
          or (target_activity_kind = 'SERVICE' and ee.service_verification_id is not null)
          or (target_activity_kind in ('OPERATIONS', 'ADMIN') and ee.manual_basis_id is not null)
        )
    ), grouped_expense as (
      select source_kind, label, sum(amount_vnd)::bigint as amount_vnd
      from raw_expense
      group by source_kind, label
    )
    select coalesce(
      jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'source_kind', source_kind,
          'label', label,
          'amount_vnd', amount_vnd
        )
        order by amount_vnd desc, label
      ),
      '[]'::jsonb
    )
    into expense_items
    from grouped_expense;
  end if;

  commission_quality := case
    when not can_compensation then 'FORBIDDEN'
    when target_activity_kind is not null and target_activity_kind <> 'SALES' then 'NOT_APPLICABLE'
    else 'READY'
  end;

  if commission_quality = 'READY' then
    with commission_balance as (
      select
        ee.employee_id,
        coalesce(emp.display_name, 'Nhan vien')::text as employee_name,
        ee.id as earning_event_id,
        (
          p.original_amount_vnd
          + coalesce((
            select sum(pa.amount_delta_vnd)
            from public.payable_adjustments pa
            where pa.obligation_id = p.id
              and pa.recorded_at <= effective_to
              and pa.recorded_at <= effective_cutoff
          ), 0)
          - coalesce((
            select sum(a.amount_delta_vnd)
            from public.payment_allocations a
            where a.payable_obligation_id = p.id
              and a.allocated_at <= effective_to
              and a.allocated_at <= effective_cutoff
          ), 0)
        )::bigint as outstanding_amount_vnd
      from public.payable_obligations p
      join public.earning_events ee on ee.id = p.earning_event_id
      left join public.employees emp on emp.id = ee.employee_id
      left join public.sales_orders so on so.id = ee.sales_order_id
      where p.branch_id = target_branch_id
        and ee.classification = 'SALES_COMMISSION'
        and p.recorded_at <= effective_to
        and p.recorded_at <= effective_cutoff
        and (target_customer_id is null or so.customer_id = target_customer_id)
        and (target_site_id is null or so.site_id = target_site_id)
        and (target_sales_employee_id is null or ee.employee_id = target_sales_employee_id)
    ), grouped_commission as (
      select
        employee_id,
        employee_name,
        count(distinct earning_event_id)::integer as event_count,
        sum(outstanding_amount_vnd)::bigint as outstanding_amount_vnd
      from commission_balance
      group by employee_id, employee_name
      having sum(outstanding_amount_vnd) <> 0
    )
    select coalesce(
      jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'employee_id', employee_id,
          'employee_name', employee_name,
          'event_count', event_count,
          'outstanding_amount_vnd', outstanding_amount_vnd
        )
        order by outstanding_amount_vnd desc, employee_name
      ),
      '[]'::jsonb
    )
    into commission_items
    from grouped_commission;
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'expense_breakdown', jsonb_build_object(
      'quality', expense_quality,
      'items', expense_items
    ),
    'commission_detail', jsonb_build_object(
      'quality', commission_quality,
      'items', commission_items
    )
  );
end;
$function$

functions.name: finance_dashboard_snapshot
functions.args: target_branch_id uuid, from_inclusive timestamp with time zone, to_exclusive timestamp with time zone, knowledge_cutoff timestamp with time zone, target_customer_id uuid, target_site_id uuid, target_sales_employee_id uuid, target_activity_kind text
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finance_dashboard_snapshot(target_branch_id uuid, from_inclusive timestamp with time zone, to_exclusive timestamp with time zone, knowledge_cutoff timestamp with time zone, target_customer_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, target_site_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, target_sales_employee_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, target_activity_kind text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare effective_to timestamptz:=least(to_exclusive,now()); effective_cutoff timestamptz:=least(knowledge_cutoff,now()); can_profit boolean; can_expense boolean; can_ar boolean; can_ap boolean; can_comp boolean; revenue_total bigint:=0; direct_cost_total bigint:=0; opex_total bigint:=0; ar_total bigint:=0; ap_total bigint:=0; salary_total bigint:=0; commission_total bigint:=0; cost_incomplete boolean:=false; opex_not_applicable boolean:=false; unsupported_activity boolean:=target_activity_kind is not null and target_activity_kind not in ('DELIVERY','SERVICE','SALES','OPERATIONS','ADMIN');
begin
  if not private.has_permission(target_branch_id,'dashboard.read') then raise exception 'forbidden' using errcode='42501'; end if;
  if from_inclusive>=to_exclusive then raise exception 'invalid_report_period' using errcode='22023'; end if;
  can_profit:=private.has_permission(target_branch_id,'finance.profit.read'); can_expense:=private.has_permission(target_branch_id,'finance.expense.read'); can_ar:=private.has_permission(target_branch_id,'finance.ar.read'); can_ap:=private.has_permission(target_branch_id,'finance.ap.read'); can_comp:=private.has_permission(target_branch_id,'compensation.read');
  select coalesce(sum(amount),0)::bigint into revenue_total from (
    select r.amount_vnd amount from public.revenue_entries r join public.sales_orders o on o.id=r.sales_order_id where r.branch_id=target_branch_id and r.recorded_at>=from_inclusive and r.recorded_at<effective_to and r.recorded_at<=effective_cutoff and (target_customer_id is null or o.customer_id=target_customer_id) and (target_site_id is null or o.site_id=target_site_id) and (target_sales_employee_id is null or o.sales_owner_employee_id=target_sales_employee_id) and (target_activity_kind is null or target_activity_kind='DELIVERY')
    union all
    select v.billable_amount_vnd from public.service_verifications v join public.service_jobs j on j.id=v.service_job_id where j.branch_id=target_branch_id and v.verified_at>=from_inclusive and v.verified_at<effective_to and v.verified_at<=effective_cutoff and (target_customer_id is null or j.customer_id=target_customer_id) and (target_site_id is null or j.site_id=target_site_id) and (target_sales_employee_id is null or j.sales_employee_id=target_sales_employee_id) and (target_activity_kind is null or target_activity_kind='SERVICE')
    union all
    select ra.amount_delta_vnd from public.revenue_adjustments ra
      left join public.sales_orders o on o.id=ra.sales_order_id left join public.service_verifications sv on sv.id=ra.service_verification_id
      left join public.service_jobs j on j.id=sv.service_job_id
      where ra.branch_id=target_branch_id and ra.recorded_at>=from_inclusive and ra.recorded_at<effective_to and ra.recorded_at<=effective_cutoff
        and (target_customer_id is null or coalesce(o.customer_id,j.customer_id)=target_customer_id)
        and (target_site_id is null or coalesce(o.site_id,j.site_id)=target_site_id)
        and (target_sales_employee_id is null or coalesce(o.sales_owner_employee_id,j.sales_employee_id)=target_sales_employee_id)
        and (target_activity_kind is null or(target_activity_kind='DELIVERY' and ra.sales_order_id is not null) or(target_activity_kind='SERVICE' and ra.service_verification_id is not null))
    union all
    select a.amount_delta_vnd from public.receivable_adjustments a join public.receivable_obligations ro on ro.id=a.obligation_id
      join public.delivery_verifications dv on dv.id=ro.delivery_verification_id join public.deliveries d on d.id=dv.delivery_id
      join public.sales_orders o on o.id=d.sales_order_id
      where ro.branch_id=target_branch_id and a.return_case_id is not null and a.recorded_at>=from_inclusive and a.recorded_at<effective_to and a.recorded_at<=effective_cutoff
        and not exists(select 1 from public.revenue_adjustments ra where ra.receivable_adjustment_id=a.id)
        and (target_customer_id is null or o.customer_id=target_customer_id) and (target_site_id is null or o.site_id=target_site_id)
        and (target_sales_employee_id is null or o.sales_owner_employee_id=target_sales_employee_id) and(target_activity_kind is null or target_activity_kind='DELIVERY')
  ) revenue;
  if can_profit then
    select coalesce(sum(amount),0)::bigint into direct_cost_total from (
      select d.amount_delta_vnd amount from public.direct_cost_entries d join public.sales_orders o on o.id=d.sales_order_id where d.branch_id=target_branch_id and d.recorded_at>=from_inclusive and d.recorded_at<effective_to and d.recorded_at<=effective_cutoff and (target_customer_id is null or o.customer_id=target_customer_id) and (target_site_id is null or o.site_id=target_site_id) and (target_sales_employee_id is null or o.sales_owner_employee_id=target_sales_employee_id) and (target_activity_kind is null or target_activity_kind='DELIVERY')
      union all
      select e.amount_vnd from public.expenses e join public.delivery_expense_sources s on s.expense_id=e.id join public.deliveries d on d.id=s.delivery_id join public.sales_orders o on o.id=d.sales_order_id
       where e.branch_id=target_branch_id and e.approval_state='APPROVED' and s.cost_scope='DIRECT_DELIVERY'
       and e.effective_at>=from_inclusive and e.effective_at<effective_to and e.approved_at<=effective_cutoff
       and (target_customer_id is null or o.customer_id=target_customer_id) and(target_site_id is null or o.site_id=target_site_id)
       and(target_sales_employee_id is null or o.sales_owner_employee_id=target_sales_employee_id) and(target_activity_kind is null or target_activity_kind='DELIVERY')
      union all
      select ee.approved_amount_vnd from public.earning_events ee left join public.service_verifications sv on sv.id=ee.service_verification_id left join public.service_jobs sj on sj.id=sv.service_job_id left join public.work_item_verifications wv on wv.id=ee.work_item_verification_id left join public.work_items wi on wi.id=wv.work_item_id left join public.deliveries d on d.id=wi.delivery_id left join public.sales_orders wo on wo.id=d.sales_order_id left join public.sales_orders so on so.id=ee.sales_order_id where ee.branch_id=target_branch_id and ee.approval_state='APPROVED' and ee.classification='DIRECT_LABOR' and ee.approved_at>=from_inclusive and ee.approved_at<effective_to and ee.approved_at<=effective_cutoff and (target_customer_id is null or coalesce(sj.customer_id,wo.customer_id,so.customer_id)=target_customer_id) and (target_site_id is null or coalesce(sj.site_id,wo.site_id,so.site_id)=target_site_id) and (target_sales_employee_id is null or coalesce(sj.sales_employee_id,wo.sales_owner_employee_id,so.sales_owner_employee_id)=target_sales_employee_id) and (target_activity_kind is null or (target_activity_kind='SERVICE' and ee.service_verification_id is not null) or (target_activity_kind='DELIVERY' and wi.delivery_id is not null))
    ) costs;
    select exists(select 1 from public.delivery_verifications dv join public.deliveries d on d.id=dv.delivery_id
      join public.sales_orders o on o.id=d.sales_order_id where d.branch_id=target_branch_id
       and dv.verified_at>=from_inclusive and dv.verified_at<effective_to and dv.verified_at<=effective_cutoff
       and (target_customer_id is null or o.customer_id=target_customer_id) and (target_site_id is null or o.site_id=target_site_id)
       and (target_sales_employee_id is null or o.sales_owner_employee_id=target_sales_employee_id) and(target_activity_kind is null or target_activity_kind='DELIVERY')
       and not private.delivery_cost_sources_complete(dv.id,effective_cutoff)) into cost_incomplete;
  end if;
  if can_expense and not private.has_permission(target_branch_id,'inventory.cost.read') and not can_profit and exists(
   select 1 from public.supplier_return_credits c join public.supplier_return_cases sc on sc.id=c.case_id where c.branch_id=target_branch_id and sc.warehouse_id is not null
   and c.approved_at>=from_inclusive and c.approved_at<effective_to and c.approved_at<=effective_cutoff) then can_expense:=false;end if;
  if can_expense then
    select coalesce(sum(amount),0)::bigint into opex_total from (
      select e.amount_vnd amount from public.expenses e where e.branch_id=target_branch_id and e.approval_state='APPROVED' and not exists(select 1 from public.delivery_expense_sources ds where ds.expense_id=e.id and ds.cost_scope='DIRECT_DELIVERY') and e.effective_at>=from_inclusive and e.effective_at<effective_to and e.approved_at<=effective_cutoff and (target_customer_id is null or e.customer_id=target_customer_id) and (target_site_id is null or e.site_id=target_site_id) and (target_sales_employee_id is null or e.sales_employee_id=target_sales_employee_id) and (target_activity_kind is null or e.activity_kind=target_activity_kind)
      union all
      select ee.approved_amount_vnd from public.earning_events ee left join public.sales_orders so on so.id=ee.sales_order_id left join public.service_verifications sv on sv.id=ee.service_verification_id left join public.service_jobs sj on sj.id=sv.service_job_id where ee.branch_id=target_branch_id and ee.approval_state='APPROVED' and ee.classification in ('OPEX','SALES_COMMISSION') and ee.approved_at>=from_inclusive and ee.approved_at<effective_to and ee.approved_at<=effective_cutoff and (target_customer_id is null or coalesce(so.customer_id,sj.customer_id)=target_customer_id) and (target_site_id is null or coalesce(so.site_id,sj.site_id)=target_site_id) and (target_sales_employee_id is null or ee.employee_id=target_sales_employee_id) and (target_activity_kind is null or (target_activity_kind='SALES' and ee.classification='SALES_COMMISSION') or (target_activity_kind='SERVICE' and ee.service_verification_id is not null) or (target_activity_kind in ('OPERATIONS','ADMIN') and ee.manual_basis_id is not null))
      union all
      select e.value_vnd from public.warehouse_transfer_events e join public.warehouse_transfers t on t.id=e.transfer_id
       where t.branch_id=target_branch_id and e.event_kind='APPROVE_LOSS' and e.recorded_at>=from_inclusive and e.recorded_at<effective_to and e.recorded_at<=effective_cutoff
       and target_customer_id is null and target_site_id is null and target_sales_employee_id is null and(target_activity_kind is null or target_activity_kind='OPERATIONS')
      union all
      select coalesce(e.inventory_value_vnd,e.source_value_vnd)-c.approved_credit_vnd from public.supplier_return_credits c join public.supplier_return_events e on e.id=c.acceptance_event_id
       join public.supplier_return_cases sc on sc.id=c.case_id left join public.return_cases rc on rc.id=sc.source_return_case_id
       left join public.delivery_lines ln on ln.id=rc.delivery_line_id left join public.deliveries dd on dd.id=ln.delivery_id left join public.sales_orders so on so.id=dd.sales_order_id
       where c.branch_id=target_branch_id and c.approved_at>=from_inclusive and c.approved_at<effective_to and c.approved_at<=effective_cutoff
       and coalesce(e.inventory_value_vnd,e.source_value_vnd)<>c.approved_credit_vnd
       and(target_customer_id is null or so.customer_id=target_customer_id) and(target_site_id is null or so.site_id=target_site_id)
       and(target_sales_employee_id is null or so.sales_owner_employee_id=target_sales_employee_id)
       and(target_activity_kind is null or(target_activity_kind='DELIVERY' and sc.source_fulfillment_line_id is not null) or(target_activity_kind='OPERATIONS' and sc.source_receipt_line_id is not null))
    ) expenses_all;
    opex_not_applicable := (target_customer_id is not null or target_site_id is not null or target_sales_employee_id is not null) and (exists(select 1 from public.expenses e where e.branch_id=target_branch_id and e.approval_state='APPROVED' and not exists(select 1 from public.delivery_expense_sources ds where ds.expense_id=e.id and ds.cost_scope='DIRECT_DELIVERY') and e.effective_at>=from_inclusive and e.effective_at<effective_to and e.approved_at<=effective_cutoff and ((target_customer_id is not null and e.customer_id is null) or (target_site_id is not null and e.site_id is null) or (target_sales_employee_id is not null and e.sales_employee_id is null))) or exists(select 1 from public.earning_events ee where ee.branch_id=target_branch_id and ee.approval_state='APPROVED' and ee.classification='OPEX' and ee.manual_basis_id is not null and ee.approved_at>=from_inclusive and ee.approved_at<effective_to and ee.approved_at<=effective_cutoff));
  end if;
  if can_expense and (target_customer_id is not null or target_site_id is not null or target_sales_employee_id is not null) and exists(
   select 1 from public.warehouse_transfer_events e join public.warehouse_transfers t on t.id=e.transfer_id where t.branch_id=target_branch_id and e.event_kind='APPROVE_LOSS'
    and e.recorded_at>=from_inclusive and e.recorded_at<effective_to and e.recorded_at<=effective_cutoff and(target_activity_kind is null or target_activity_kind='OPERATIONS')) then opex_not_applicable:=true;end if;
  if can_expense and(target_customer_id is not null or target_site_id is not null or target_sales_employee_id is not null) and exists(
   select 1 from public.supplier_return_credits c join public.supplier_return_events e on e.id=c.acceptance_event_id join public.supplier_return_cases sc on sc.id=c.case_id
    where c.branch_id=target_branch_id and sc.source_receipt_line_id is not null and coalesce(e.inventory_value_vnd,e.source_value_vnd)<>c.approved_credit_vnd and c.approved_at>=from_inclusive and c.approved_at<effective_to and c.approved_at<=effective_cutoff
    and(target_activity_kind is null or target_activity_kind='OPERATIONS')) then opex_not_applicable:=true;end if;
  if can_ar then select coalesce(sum(r.original_amount_vnd+coalesce((select sum(a.amount_delta_vnd) from public.receivable_adjustments a where a.obligation_id=r.id and a.recorded_at<=effective_to and a.recorded_at<=effective_cutoff),0)-coalesce((select sum(a.amount_delta_vnd) from public.payment_allocations a where a.receivable_obligation_id=r.id and a.allocated_at<=effective_to and a.allocated_at<=effective_cutoff),0)),0)::bigint into ar_total from public.receivable_obligations r left join public.delivery_verifications dv on dv.id=r.delivery_verification_id left join public.deliveries d on d.id=dv.delivery_id left join public.sales_orders so on so.id=d.sales_order_id left join public.service_verifications sv on sv.id=r.service_verification_id left join public.service_jobs sj on sj.id=sv.service_job_id where r.branch_id=target_branch_id and r.recorded_at<=effective_to and r.recorded_at<=effective_cutoff and (target_customer_id is null or r.customer_id=target_customer_id) and (target_site_id is null or r.site_id=target_site_id) and (target_sales_employee_id is null or coalesce(so.sales_owner_employee_id,sj.sales_employee_id)=target_sales_employee_id); end if;
  if can_ap then select coalesce(sum(p.original_amount_vnd+coalesce((select sum(a.amount_delta_vnd) from public.payable_adjustments a where a.obligation_id=p.id and a.recorded_at<=effective_to and a.recorded_at<=effective_cutoff),0)-coalesce((select sum(a.amount_delta_vnd) from public.payment_allocations a where a.payable_obligation_id=p.id and a.allocated_at<=effective_to and a.allocated_at<=effective_cutoff),0)),0)::bigint into ap_total from public.payable_obligations p where p.branch_id=target_branch_id and p.recorded_at<=effective_to and p.recorded_at<=effective_cutoff; end if;
  if can_comp then
    select coalesce(sum(p.original_amount_vnd+coalesce((select sum(a.amount_delta_vnd) from public.payable_adjustments a where a.obligation_id=p.id and a.recorded_at<=effective_to and a.recorded_at<=effective_cutoff),0)-coalesce((select sum(a.amount_delta_vnd) from public.payment_allocations a where a.payable_obligation_id=p.id and a.allocated_at<=effective_to and a.allocated_at<=effective_cutoff),0)),0)::bigint into salary_total from public.payable_obligations p join public.earning_events ee on ee.id=p.earning_event_id where p.branch_id=target_branch_id and ee.classification<>'SALES_COMMISSION' and p.recorded_at<=effective_to and p.recorded_at<=effective_cutoff;
    select coalesce(sum(p.original_amount_vnd+coalesce((select sum(a.amount_delta_vnd) from public.payable_adjustments a where a.obligation_id=p.id and a.recorded_at<=effective_to and a.recorded_at<=effective_cutoff),0)-coalesce((select sum(a.amount_delta_vnd) from public.payment_allocations a where a.payable_obligation_id=p.id and a.allocated_at<=effective_to and a.allocated_at<=effective_cutoff),0)),0)::bigint into commission_total from public.payable_obligations p join public.earning_events ee on ee.id=p.earning_event_id left join public.sales_orders so on so.id=ee.sales_order_id where p.branch_id=target_branch_id and ee.classification='SALES_COMMISSION' and p.recorded_at<=effective_to and p.recorded_at<=effective_cutoff and (target_customer_id is null or so.customer_id=target_customer_id) and (target_site_id is null or so.site_id=target_site_id) and (target_sales_employee_id is null or ee.employee_id=target_sales_employee_id);
  end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('scope',(jsonb_build_object('from',from_inclusive,'to',effective_to,'as_of',effective_cutoff,'branch_id',target_branch_id)||private.branch_recording_scope(target_branch_id,effective_cutoff)),'revenue',jsonb_build_object('value_vnd',case when not unsupported_activity then (revenue_total)::text else null end,'quality',case when unsupported_activity then 'NOT_APPLICABLE' else 'READY' end),'direct_cost',jsonb_build_object('value_vnd',case when can_profit and not cost_incomplete and not unsupported_activity then (direct_cost_total)::text else null end,'quality',case when not can_profit then 'FORBIDDEN' when unsupported_activity then 'NOT_APPLICABLE' when cost_incomplete then 'INCOMPLETE' else 'READY' end),'gross_profit',jsonb_build_object('value_vnd',case when can_profit and not cost_incomplete and not unsupported_activity then (revenue_total-direct_cost_total)::text else null end,'quality',case when not can_profit then 'FORBIDDEN' when unsupported_activity then 'NOT_APPLICABLE' when cost_incomplete then 'INCOMPLETE' else 'READY' end),'operating_expense',jsonb_build_object('value_vnd',case when can_expense and not opex_not_applicable then (opex_total)::text else null end,'quality',case when not can_expense then 'FORBIDDEN' when opex_not_applicable then 'NOT_APPLICABLE' else 'READY' end),'operating_profit',jsonb_build_object('value_vnd',case when can_profit and can_expense and not cost_incomplete and not opex_not_applicable and not unsupported_activity then (revenue_total-direct_cost_total-opex_total)::text else null end,'quality',case when not can_profit or not can_expense then 'FORBIDDEN' when unsupported_activity then 'NOT_APPLICABLE' when cost_incomplete then 'INCOMPLETE' when opex_not_applicable then 'NOT_APPLICABLE' else 'READY' end),'operating_margin_bps',jsonb_build_object('value',case when revenue_total>0 and can_profit and can_expense and not cost_incomplete and not opex_not_applicable and not unsupported_activity then ((revenue_total-direct_cost_total-opex_total)::numeric*10000/revenue_total) else null end,'quality',case when not can_profit or not can_expense then 'FORBIDDEN' when unsupported_activity then 'NOT_APPLICABLE' when cost_incomplete then 'INCOMPLETE' when opex_not_applicable then 'NOT_APPLICABLE' else 'READY' end),'receivable',jsonb_build_object('value_vnd',case when can_ar then (ar_total)::text else null end,'quality',case when can_ar then 'READY' else 'FORBIDDEN' end),'payable',jsonb_build_object('value_vnd',case when can_ap and target_customer_id is null and target_site_id is null and target_sales_employee_id is null then (ap_total)::text else null end,'quality',case when not can_ap then 'FORBIDDEN' when target_customer_id is not null or target_site_id is not null or target_sales_employee_id is not null then 'NOT_APPLICABLE' else 'READY' end),'salary_payable',jsonb_build_object('value_vnd',case when can_comp and target_customer_id is null and target_site_id is null and target_sales_employee_id is null and target_activity_kind is null then (salary_total)::text else null end,'quality',case when not can_comp then 'FORBIDDEN' when target_customer_id is not null or target_site_id is not null or target_sales_employee_id is not null or target_activity_kind is not null then 'NOT_APPLICABLE' else 'READY' end),'commission_payable',jsonb_build_object('value_vnd',case when can_comp and (target_activity_kind is null or target_activity_kind='SALES') then (commission_total)::text else null end,'quality',case when not can_comp then 'FORBIDDEN' when target_activity_kind is not null and target_activity_kind<>'SALES' then 'NOT_APPLICABLE' else 'READY' end));
end $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gps_fleet_snapshot(target_branch_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(session_id uuid, delivery_id uuid, delivery_number text, vehicle_id uuid, plate_number text, employee_id uuid, employee_name text, latitude numeric, longitude numeric, accuracy_meters numeric, captured_at timestamp with time zone, received_at timestamp with time zone, is_stale boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare stale_seconds integer;
begin
  if not private.has_permission(target_branch_id, 'delivery.read') then
    raise exception 'forbidden' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  select coalesce(s.gps_stale_after_seconds, 300) into stale_seconds from public.routing_settings s where s.branch_id = target_branch_id;
  stale_seconds := coalesce(stale_seconds, 300);
  return query
  select s.id, d.id, d.delivery_number, s.vehicle_id, v.plate_number, s.employee_id, e.display_name,
    p.latitude, p.longitude, p.accuracy_meters, p.captured_at, p.received_at,
    p.received_at < now() - make_interval(secs => stale_seconds)
  from public.gps_tracking_sessions s
  join public.deliveries d on d.id = s.delivery_id and d.execution_state in ('ASSIGNED','DISPATCHED','ARRIVED','RESULT_SUBMITTED')
  join public.delivery_assignments a on a.id = s.assignment_id and a.superseded_at is null and a.assignment_version = s.assignment_version
  join public.vehicles v on v.id = s.vehicle_id
  join public.employees e on e.id = s.employee_id
  join lateral (
    select gp.latitude, gp.longitude, gp.accuracy_meters, gp.captured_at, gp.received_at
    from public.gps_positions gp where gp.session_id = s.id order by gp.sequence desc limit 1
  ) p on true
  where s.branch_id = target_branch_id and s.status = 'ACTIVE'
  order by p.received_at desc, s.id;
end
$function$

 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare bounded_size integer;
begin
  if not private.has_permission(target_branch_id, 'finance.ar.read') then
    raise exception 'forbidden' using errcode = '42501';

  bounded_size := least(100, greatest(1, coalesce(page_size, 50)));

    select o.id, o.customer_id, c.display_name,
      case when o.delivery_verification_id is not null then 'DELIVERY_VERIFICATION' else 'SERVICE_VERIFICATION' end,
      coalesce(o.delivery_verification_id, o.service_verification_id), o.original_amount_vnd,

    from public.receivable_obligations o

    where o.branch_id = target_branch_id
